reason: A client-side DSH web plugin for managing installed visual skins through a draggable floating button, with skin selection and layout state persisted locally.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面管理和切换已安装皮肤的客户端浮动按钮插件。
summaries.en: A client-side floating-button plugin for managing and switching installed skins in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Provides a draggable floating UI control
Detects installed skin packages through the host loader
Switches skin visibility by modifying page attributes and CSS
Persists skin selection and button position in localStorage
